svg.aria-label: Three libraries: Frontend (22 skills plus an editable house-style primer), Landing pages and Workflow. Served, not copied: The MCP server serves them into your live session. They are not copied into your repo. Source: claude_development_skills (https://github.com/VelimirMueller/claude_development_skills), vendored under vendor/skills/. Storage: The project DB skills table (fe:*, la:*, wf:*). Edit them. Re-seeds never overwrite your edits. Opt-in: /kickoff asks once. update_skill_sets({ landing: true, ... }) changes it any time. Update: CODE_CONTEXT_SKILLS_AUTOSYNC=1 syncs from the latest upstream release at boot. npm run sync:skills re-vendors the offline fallback. Frontend playbook: /kickoff loads the frontend skill playbook into the session when a sprint has fe-engineer work. Full guidance: Pull the full guidance of any skill with get_skill. Details: docs/REFERENCE.md (skill sets)
